name: Kitzbühel
kurzbeschreibung: The legendary city of the Hahnenkammrennen. Glamour, tradition, and breathtaking alpine scenery. Innsbruck—where the mountains meet the world.
beschreibung:
Kitzbühel lies at an elevation of 762 meters in the district of the same name in the Kitzbüheler Alpen and has around 8,200 inhabitants. The town looks back on more than 750 years of history, shaped by medieval silver mining, which still gives the old town with its narrow alleys and colorful house facades a distinctive character today. First mentioned in a document in 1271, Kitzbühel was once one of the richest mining towns in Tirol.

The name Kitzbühel is inextricably linked worldwide with the Hahnenkammrennen, which attracts thousands to the notorious Streif every January. The downhill at the Hahnenkamm, with its Mausefalle and the steep Hausberg-Kante, is one of the most demanding courses in the Ski World Cup. 🏔️ In winter, around 230 kilometers of pistes and more than 50 mountain railways are available; in summer, the region transforms into an expansive hiking and mountain biking area with over 1,000 kilometers of marked trails. The Kitzbüheler Hornbahn takes visitors up to 2,000 meters, where a unique panoramic view of 70 three-thousanders awaits.

Culinary offerings range from a traditional Tiroler Beisl with Kaspressknödel and Tiroler Gröstl to upscale Haubenküche in restaurants such as Restaurant Rosengarten. The town is considered one of the most exclusive places in Österreich, reflected in the numerous luxury shops around the Vorderstadt. Anyone who visits Kitzbühel experiences a rare mix of sporting seriousness, sophisticated flair, and lived Tiroler tradition – and that in every season.
